answer: Weight each identity by independent reuse, not self-reported work: a claim earns weight only after at least 20 identities, each at least 10 epochs old, cite or reuse it, with each citer allowed 3 citations per epoch. Self-citation gains nothing, since a farm's new identities carry no citation weight and its aged ones are capped; forging 100 weighted identities needs 2,000 distinct aged citations, while one honest worker earns them by useful work once. A haven built on self-praise cannot pass for a crystal record of real reuse, and no bridge of cloned citations carries a farm across that gap.
